targets.title: A computational and neural model of momentary subjective well-being.
targets.evidence_quote:
In this paper, we report a preregistered close replication of the behavioural

experiment and analyses by Rutledge et al. (2014).
targets.outcome_quote:
First, we aimed to replicate the behavioural results

reported by Rutledge et al. (2014). In general, this study can be considered a successful

replication. We specified several criteria to evaluate the success of replication and almost all

criteria were met.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The discussion explicitly judges the study overall a successful replication. Under rule 1 that overall verdict governs despite a higher forgetting factor and unsuccessful model-comparison result. The latter contrasts are acknowledged rather than silently omitted.

reasoning: A new sample of 50 participants retests the behavioral findings in the original paper. Reusing experimental code and conducting alternative analyses of new data does not make this a reproduction. Title, authors and DOI match the supplied work. Complete accepted manuscript includes references and appended supplementary material.
